evidence.reason: `read_completions` uses `splitlines()`, which includes a trailing unterminated fragment as a line. For an append-only completion log, only newline-terminated records are complete; a concurrent or partial append can therefore make the reader attempt to parse an incomplete JSON object and raise `RuntimeError`. The smallest compatible fix is to split on newline and ignore the final unterminated tail, as the finding suggests. This is a minor correctness fix in the existing reader behavior.
